name: Crypto prices
description: Cryptocurrency spot prices from the free CoinGecko API. No key needed.

operations.name: crypto.price
operations.description: The current spot price of a cryptocurrency in a fiat currency.

inputs.name: coin
inputs.description: CoinGecko coin id, lowercase: bitcoin, ethereum, solana, dogecoin

inputs.name: currency
inputs.description: Fiat currency code, lowercase: usd, eur, try

outputs.name: price
outputs.description: One coin in the requested currency

operations.howto: Bind coin and currency as lowercase constants or from select elements; run on a click and route price into a state key. Multiply holdings with expr.evaluate (vars). Coin ids are full names like "bitcoin", never ticker symbols. No credential needed.
